precision.raw_data: JSON number|string|boolean|null recursively; never coerce exact strings

authentication.headless: caller-supplied bearer, fresh per request; renewal owned by caller
authentication.browser: same operation suffix under /bff/api/v1 with native cookie session and CSRF on writes
authentication.tokens_management: interactive verified identity required; PAT cannot mint or manage PATs
authentication.applications_management: interactive owner identity required; personal tokens and application credentials cannot approve or manage authorizations

semantics.writes: no automatic retries; explicit chat client_request_id supports server idempotency
semantics.null: omitted provider secret preserves, explicit null clears; optional request fields preserve explicit null where server accepts it
semantics.streams: close/cancel consuming stream releases HTTP response; explicit cancel endpoint cancels durable run; no automatic reconnect
semantics.preconditions: content writes require current sha256/snapshot_id via If-Match; no forced overwrite helper
semantics.paging: honor only endpoint-declared query parameters; Page fields optional for items-only endpoints

excluded.reason: browser session introspection; headless SDK uses verified bearer/profile/context
public operator probes outside versioned API; deployment HTTP checks
Retained routes are excluded except the explicit qualified_compatibility_operations list; operation admission depends on deployment prerequisites and current authority
